note: Seed list from meshsonar-infra observer-everywhere-mqtt-plan-2026-11-15.md section 6 (maintained preset files of Cisien meshcoretomqtt and agessaman meshcore-packet-capture, read Nov 15 2026). Every preset ships OFF in the app. A preset says the broker exists, not that its operator accepts phone publishers; presets with needsOperatorOk are shown with a plain-words warning first. No shared credentials and no plain-tcp brokers are listed: those are reachable only through Custom.

presets.name: LetsMesh US
presets.caution: This site may only want fixed observers, not phones. Ask the operator before you turn it on. Its terms are unverified. The WebSocket path is uncertain (sources disagree); if it does not connect, use Test and try the other path under Custom.

presets.caution: This site may only want fixed observers, not phones. Ask the operator before you turn it on. Its terms are unverified. The WebSocket path is uncertain (sources disagree); if it does not connect, use Test and try the other path under Custom.

presets.name: MeshMapper
presets.caution: MeshMapper discourages phone observers and wants a MeshMapper region code as the topic area. Ask the operator before you turn it on. The WebSocket path is uncertain (sources disagree); if it does not connect, use Test and try the other path under Custom.
